backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files describing components, styles, and configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and utility layers with OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with SEO meta tags, canonical link, Open Graph tags, and LocalBusiness JSON-LD.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots file allowing all crawlers and pointing to sitemap.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: Sitemap listing site root with weekly change frequency.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with service mappings, HOT pick content, components, analytics, and in‑page navigation.
frontend/src/components/BusinessHighligh: Highlights strip showing location, hours, call, and WhatsApp with optional GA tracking.
frontend/src/components/HotFab.tsx: Floating HOT PICK button linking to hot-pick section with click handler.
frontend/src/components/HotPickSection.t: Displays a featured Motorola smartphone section with image, description, highlights, and store details.
frontend/src/components/MobileCareSmartU: Shows mobile care tips with an expandable modal listing all facts.
frontend/src/components/SafeImage.tsx: Image component with error handling and fallback UI options.
frontend/src/components/TickerBanner.tsx: Renders a horizontally scrolling ticker banner of product categories.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppQuickMes: Provides a WhatsApp button with preset quick messages in a popover.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Handles Internet Identity auth lifecycle, exposing identity, login, logout, and status via context.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theming variables, animations, and utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/analyticsConfig.ts: Centralizes analytics configuration for GTM and GA4 using environment variables.
frontend/src/lib/assetVersion.ts: Provides asset versioning and a helper to append version query strings for cache-busting.
frontend/src/lib/clickTracking.ts: Delegated click tracking that sends GA4 events for context-tagged elements, WhatsApp links, and tel links, with safe initialization and cleanup.
frontend/src/lib/ga4.ts: Lightweight GA4 wrapper providing safe checks and helpers for custom events and SPA page_view tracking.
frontend/src/lib/googleTracking.ts: Initializes GTM and verifies GA4 setup with idempotent script injection based on analytics configuration.
frontend/src/lib/scrollDepthTracking.ts: Tracks scroll depth at set thresholds using rAF throttling and fires GA4 events once per page load.
frontend/src/lib/spaPageViews.ts: Patches history APIs and listens to popstate to send GA4 page_view events on SPA navigation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider, rendering App into root.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, typography, animations, and layout utilities with plugin support.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing active SEO improvement tasks, constraints, and existing feature requirements.
